concerns.text: Success Criteria SC-001 and SC-002 require verifying specific statistical thresholds (Δr ≥ 0.05, ΔAUC lower CI ≥ 0.05) as the definition of project success. However, tasks T043 and T044 (which would generate the final metrics and report) are marked as unchecked/missing, leaving no implemented task to actually calculate, verify, and report these specific success criteria.

FR-005 requires a sensitivity analysis sweeping 'r' over the specific representative range {0.15, 0.20, 0.25}. Task T033 vaguely describes sweeping 'r' 'across a range of low values' without specifying the exact values, failing to guarantee the specific testable condition defined in the spec.

FR-008 requires the baseline connectivity model to use 200 PCA components. Tasks T023c and T023d introduce a secondary 'reduced feature' set via L1 regularization for 'exploratory analysis,' creating ambiguity about which feature set constitutes the primary baseline for SC-001/SC-002 verification, risking implementation of the wrong model for the primary success criteria.

FR-011 mandates subsampling all valid subjects to a fixed N=120 time series length *before* entropy calculation to ensure consistent SampEn length bias. Tasks T015a and T015b explicitly instruct calculating entropy on the variable-length scrubbed series first, contradicting the spec's requirement for length standardization prior to computation.
